About The College
J.B. Hagjer Degree College was established in 1995. It was permitted by Assam University, Silchar (established under the central University Act III of 1989).
				At present, the College is temporary Affiliated to the Assam University, Silchar.
				The college is located at Umrongso; the remote corner of the Dima Hasao district and this is the only educational institution imparting higher education to students mostly belonging to the tribal communities in this area.
Read More
From the Principal's Chair...
At J.B. Hagjer Degree College we value every individual in our care and it is our aim to provide the best possible environment in which student can succeed.
I am honored and very proud to serve and lead the learning here at J.B. Hagjer Degree College, Umrongso. I am working hard to gain your trust and respect as the college's Principal-in-Charge. 
				My responsibility is to ensure that your child continues to receive high quality education within a safe and supportive environment.
